meta.note: DOM layout is not raster; WASM patch includes raster and JS buffer copy. No ratio between these unequal metrics. Equal PNG capture includes Playwright RPC/browser readback/encoding. 30 samples/run expensive captures; 200 wasm rasters; 1000 DOM updates. Legacy mail uses real predecessor fixture. Migrated layout captures per-character text/box geometry with normalized bundled font, but drops emoji fallback and CSS decorations; its PNG ratio is approximate workload only, not pixel-matched renderer speedup.
